question: Will at least one source alarm=true be registered for the object_id x system_type group in [issued_at, issued_at + 24h)?
interpretation: registered source alarm forecast; not a confirmed physical fault, incident or dispatch outcome
candidates: groups with at least one channel message strictly before issued_at; rows without object_id or system_type are out of scope and counted

label.positive: any source row with alarm=true for any channel of the group in [t, t+24h); simultaneous true/false rows are counted as conflicts, true is kept
label.negative: no alarm=true row in a fully covered window; per-channel future messages are not required
label.excluded: window touches an uncovered source day, a policy_days day scoped to a sensor type of the group (or unscoped), a split boundary, data end, 2021, or a cutoff whose 30-day lookback starts before 2019-01-01 or inside 2021

baseline.window: [t-30d, t-24h) hourly medians of the channel's own value_numeric
baseline.scale: 1.4826 * MAD, fallback IQR / 1.349; zero scale -> null with reason

features.group_aggregation: per sensor type inside the group: median, p90, max, count of channels with |z| >= pronounced_change_abs_z

prefixes.cat__: base categoricals: target system type, object kind, last signal sensor type, last observed text state
prefixes.own_num__: own group value_numeric dynamics (anything derived from value_numeric)
prefixes.comp__: composition: known channels, per sensor-type counts/shares, numeric channel share
prefixes.nbr_obj_sig__: other systems of the same object, per system code, message/alarm/recency
prefixes.nbr_obj_num__: other systems of the same object, per system code, value_numeric dynamics
prefixes.nbr_pk_sig__: channels of other groups on the same unambiguous point picket in the object
prefixes.nbr_pk_num__: value_numeric dynamics of those same-picket channels
prefixes.name__: variant E only: channel name of the last alarm and of the maximum normalized deviation; 'несколько каналов' on ties
prefixes.card__: never a model input: object/system/channel/picket context for the dispatcher card

preprocessing: drop development-constant and exact-duplicate columns; object_id/channel ids are keys only

models.rule_share: own_sig__alarm_channel_share_24h desc, then own_sig__hours_since_last_alarm asc (null = never in lookback)

evaluation.threshold: chosen on validation_2025_h1 only, maximizing F1 of the budget-capped card policy

bootstrap.cards: fixed on the full period, metrics resampled

name_transfer.evaluate: validation_2025_h1 rows split by held-in / held-out object

forbidden: using test_2026_jan_may_viewed or diagnostics to change features, parameters, threshold or subsystem choice
object_id or channel_id as model features
